propositions: The two-clone enrichment regression for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree, available only in Git 2.38+, but the repository does not declare or enforce this version floor.
The supported Git version floor must be explicitly documented and consistently enforced across contributor docs, CI, and tests to prevent the regression from silently skipping on older clients.
A runtime skip guard on older Git clients causes the regression test to vacuously pass, masking future regressions in the same manner as earlier vacuous guards (34c2, 8a5e-b88e-0c3e-4544).

The enforcement must fail the entire pytest session on under-floor Git versions with a clear diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and upgrade path, rather than skip individual tests.

All gating CI environments and local contributor setups must provably execute the real merge-tree regression assertion, verified by guards that search the test tree for the capability and reject skip machinery in any merge-tree test module.
